name: Open5GS
what_it_is: Open5GS is an open-source C-language implementation of a 5G Core (5GC) and Evolved Packet Core (EPC) for LTE/NR networks, compliant with 3GPP Release-17. It provides a full set of network functions for both 4G and 5G standalone deployments.
components: PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function — 4G EPC)
protocols: PFCP (Packet Forwarding Control Protocol — N4 interface)
SBI (Service Based Interface — HTTP/2 REST, 5G NFs)
measurement: WebUI exposes subscriber session state and data usage at port 9999
MongoDB stores subscriber records queryable via standard MongoDB tooling (port 27017)
Logs per network function (configurable log level in YAML config files)
No built-in Prometheus/metrics endpoint exposed by default
configuration: Per-NF YAML configuration files (e.g., amf.yaml, smf.yaml, upf.yaml) under /etc/open5gs/
Subscriber provisioning via WebUI (HTTP on port 9999) backed by MongoDB
Network slice configuration (S-NSSAI, TAI) in AMF and NSSF YAML files
APN/DNN and IP pool definitions in SMF/PGW YAML files
TUN device (ogstun) created by UPF/PGW-U; requires NET_ADMIN capability and TUN device access
IPv4 and IPv6 dual-stack supported in UPF data plane
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection framework; network-level faults can be introduced via Linux tc/iptables rules against GTP-U or SBI interfaces
Individual NFs can be stopped/restarted independently in Docker Compose to simulate NF failures
SCTP multi-homing failures can be simulated by manipulating network namespaces or dropping SCTP packets
modes: 5G Standalone (SA) mode: full 5GC with gNB via NGAP/N2
4G EPC mode: MME + SGW + PGW + HSS + PCRF with eNB via S1AP
NSA (Non-Standalone) partial support via EPC coexistence
Development mode (docker dev service with GUI/display support)
Test mode (docker test service with automated test runner)
constraints: Requires Linux host with TUN/TAP device support and NET_ADMIN capability; does not run on macOS or Windows natively
MongoDB is the only supported subscriber data store; no SQL or alternative backend
No built-in RAN emulator — requires an external gNB/eNB or software RAN (e.g., srsRAN, UERANSIM) to form a complete testbed
UPF data plane is kernel-space GTP-U via TUN device, not DPDK; throughput is limited compared to hardware-accelerated deployments
Licensed under GNU AGPL v3.0 — commercial use requires a separate commercial license from NewPlane
docker_services: base — base build image (no runtime role)
run — production runtime container (NET_ADMIN, TUN, IPv6)
test — automated test execution container (NET_ADMIN, TUN, IPv6)
dev — interactive development container with display support (NET_ADMIN, TUN, IPv6)
notable_absences: No built-in UE simulator or traffic generator
No Prometheus/Grafana metrics endpoint out of the box
No charging / online charging system (OCS) implementation
No IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) or VoLTE/VoNR support
No DPDK or AF_XDP fast-path UPF variant included
